description.zh:
自定义Token，保证请求幂等性。
> 支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en:
Custom token used to ensure Request idempotence.  
> ASCII characters are supported, and the length must not exceed 64 characters.

description.zh:
预期资源开始服务时间。

时间格式：`yyyy-mm-dd HH:MM:SS`。

时区是北京时间（东八区）。

> 本参数仅适用于白名单用户。
description.en:
Expected time when resources become ready to serve.

Time format: `yyyy-mm-dd HH:MM:SS`.

Time Zone is UTC+8.

> This parameter applies only to whitelist Users.

description.zh: 预期可支持的会话数量。
description.en: Expected number of sessions to support.

descriptions.zh:
当预定任务完成时，HTTP接口推送消息如下： > HTTP接口是接收会话启动、停止、串流等消息的一种方式。目前消息保存1天，重试策略为退避重试，最多重试176次。 事件类型为`CAPACITY_REEERVATION_RESULT`。 >不区分模式，仅推送HTTP接口。> | 名称 | 类型 | 是否必选 | 说明| | ------ | ------ | ------ |----- | |success|Boolean|是|任务是否成功。
取值：
true：任务成功。
false：任务失败。| |eventType|String|是|事件类型。| |eventDetail|Object[EventDetail]|是|事件详情。
当任务成功时，返回该参数。| EventDetail数据结构如下所示。 | 名称 | 类型 | 是否必选 | 说明| | ------ | ------ | ------ |----- | | taskId | String | 是 | 任务ID。 | | success | Boolean | 是 | 任务是否成功。
取值：
true：任务成功。
false：任务失败。 | | projectId | String | 是 | 项目ID。 | | appId | String | 是 | 应用ID。 | | appVersion | String | 是 | 应用版本。 | | districtId | String | 是 | 区域ID。 | | expectSessionCapacity | Integer| 是 | 期望支撑的会话数量。 | | realSessionCapacity | Integer | 是 | 实际生产出的容器能支撑的会话数量。 |
descriptions.en:
When the reservation job completes, the HTTP API pushes a message as follows: > The HTTP API is a method for receiving messages about session start, stop, streaming, and other events. Currently, messages are retained for 1 Day, and the retry policy is backoff retry, with a maximum of 176 retries. The event type is `CAPACITY_RESERVATION_RESULT`. >Regardless of pattern, messages are pushed only through the HTTP API.> | Name | Type | Required | Description | | ------ | ------ | ------ |----- | | success | Boolean | Yes | Indicates whether the job succeeded.
Valid values:
true: The job succeeded.
false: The job failed. | | eventType | String | Yes | The event type. | | eventDetail | Object[EventDetail] | Yes | The event details.
This parameter is returned only when the job succeeds. | The data structure of EventDetail is as follows: | Name | Type | Required | Description | | ------ | ------ | ------ |----- | | taskId | String | Yes | The job ID. | | success | Boolean | Yes | Indicates whether the job succeeded.
Valid values:
true: The job succeeded.
false: The job failed. | | projectId | String | Yes | The project ID. | | appId | String | Yes | The application ID. | | appVersion | String | Yes | The Application Version. | | districtId | String | Yes | The area ID. | | expectSessionCapacity | Integer | Yes | The expected number of sessions to be supported. | | realSessionCapacity | Integer | Yes | The actual number of sessions supported by the produced containers. |
